narrative_vs_numbers.summary: Infosys demonstrated disciplined operational execution throughout FY26, progressively raising its constant currency revenue guidance from 1% to 3% in Q1 FY26 to 2% to 3% in Q2 FY26 and 3% to 3.5% in Q3 FY26, ultimately delivering 3.1% full-year growth. Operating margins remained tightly defended within the guided 20% to 22% band, delivering 21% for full year FY26 and 21.1% in Q1 FY27. However, early FY27 faced headwinds as management trimmed the top end of its FY27 revenue guidance from 3.5% down to 3% following an EURS client contract termination.

guided.guidance: Revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our revenue growth guidance for the financial year 2027 is 1.5% to 3.5% growth year-on-year in constant currency terms."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%.
guided.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our operating margin guidance for financial year '27 is 20% to 22%."

delivered.actual: Revenue growth for Q1 was at 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1% Q-on-Q in constant currency terms.
delivered.source: Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Our revenue growth for Q1 was at 2.4% Y-on-Y and 1% Q-on-Q in constant currency terms."
Q1 FY27 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2026), PDF p. 5 — "Our large deals, $3.6 bn at 61% net new, operating margin at 21.1%, free cash flow at $955 mn."

quarters.commentary: Infosys met its initial Q1 trajectory within the guided FY27 band with 2.4% YoY constant currency revenue growth and a 21.1% operating margin, though an unexpected EURS client contract cancellation led management to trim the full-year top-end guidance to 3%.

guided.guidance: The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 4 — "The new revenue growth guidance for this financial year is 3% to 3.5% growth in constant currency."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%.
guided.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 4 — "Our operating margin guidance for the financial year remains the same at 20% to 22%."

delivered.actual: Growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 4 — "We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms."

delivered.actual: Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%.
delivered.source: Q4 FY26 Concall Transcript (27-Apr-2026), PDF p. 28 — "4. Adjusted operating margin was stable at 21%. Gains from currency and Maximus were reinvested in talent, AI and sales and marketing."

quarters.commentary: Full-year FY26 constant currency revenue growth concluded at 3.1%, squarely within the upgraded 3% to 3.5% guidance band, while full-year adjusted operating margin held firm at 21%.

guided.guidance: The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance remains the same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year.
guided.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "And our operating margin guidance remains the same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year."

delivered.actual: Revenue growth in 9 months stood at 2.8%, which is at the higher end of our earlier guided range.
delivered.source: Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 21 — "our revenue growth in 9 months stood at 2.8%, which is at the higher end of our earlier guided range."
Q3 FY26 Concall Transcript (19-Jan-2026), PDF p. 3 — "Our adjusted operating margin was 21.2%. We generated free cash flow of $915 mn."

quarters.commentary: Nine-month revenue growth reached 2.8%, prompting an upward guidance revision to 3% to 3.5%, while adjusted operating margin expanded to 21.2%.

guided.guidance: Revised our FY26 revenue guidance to 1% to 3% in constant currency terms.
guided.source: Q1 FY26 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2025), PDF p. 22 — "we have revised our FY26 revenue guidance to 1% to 3% in constant currency terms."

guided.guidance: Operating margin guidance for the year is 20% to 22%.
guided.source: Q1 FY26 Concall Transcript (28-Jul-2025), PDF p. 22 — "Our operating margin guidance for the year is 20% to 22%."

delivered.actual: Revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency terms.
delivered.source: Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "Our revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency terms."
Q2 FY26 Concall Transcript (21-Oct-2025), PDF p. 3 — "Our operating margin was 21%. Our large deals were at $3.1 bn, out of which 67% was net new work."

quarters.commentary: Strong execution in Q2 delivered 2.9% YoY constant currency growth and a 21% operating margin, enabling management to increase the lower end of its revenue growth guidance from 1% to 2%.

narrative_vs_numbers.pattern: Management follows a disciplined pattern of setting achievable lower bounds and upgrading through the fiscal year, while using cost efficiency levers under Project Maximus to maintain operating margins steadily around 21%.
